account.q: Do I need an account to use Foliant?
account.a: No. You can process and download documents right away as a Guest.

studio.a: Studio lets signed-in users find their saved documents, versions, and history.

privacy.a: Guest files are used for the requested processing, remain temporary, and are deleted automatically. A document saved in Studio stays available in your account until you delete it.

tools.a: Ready-to-use tools are available from the catalogue. Features still in development are marked Coming soon.

allTools.title: All Foliant tools
allTools.text: Explore every available tool. Features in development are clearly marked.

home.workspaceTitle: One clear space for every document
home.workspaceText: The page guides users to one main action, then suggests related tools when the file is ready.
home.stepsText: The flow stays short: file, action, result. Technical details stay in the background.

upload.title: Upload the file
upload.text: Select a PDF, Office document, image, or Markdown file.

choose.title: Choose the action
choose.text: Compress, convert, merge, sign, or reorder pages.

download.title: Download the result
download.text: Get the final file, run another action, or delete temporary files.

free.a: Yes, the free limit lets users process a few files per day. Higher volumes and advanced features can move to a paid plan.

install.q: Do I need to install software?
install.a: No. The tools run directly in the browser on desktop and mobile.

privacy.a: Files are stored temporarily for processing, then automatically deleted after a few hours.

signature.a: The first version focuses on simple visual signing. It does not replace certified electronic signatures.

home.toolsText: The most common tools stay visible. The rest of the catalog stays accessible without overloading the page.

convert.title: Convert and edit PDFs
convert.description: Convert to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or image, then reorder pages, add text, a watermark, or page numbers.

compress.title: Compress large files
compress.description: Reduce PDF and image size so they are faster to send by email, WhatsApp, or online forms.

merge.title: Merge multiple documents
merge.description: Combine several PDF files in the right order, then download one clean document.

sign.title: Visually sign a PDF
sign.description: Draw or import a signature, place it on the document, then download a visually signed PDF.
